business.name: MicroPatches
business.shortDescription: Custom mini patch inspired products made for law enforcement, fire, EMS, military, public safety, supporters, and collectors. Premium raised texture products designed to carry your patch style artwork anywhere.

bulkPricing.headline: Custom MicroKeychain pricing
bulkPricing.description: Current MicroKeychain pricing for individual orders, agency orders, department orders, gifts, supporters, and collectors.
bulkPricing.note: The $25 design and work-up fee prepares custom artwork for MicroPatches production and serves as a non-refundable deposit. When collected, this fee is securely processed through Stripe and is waived for 50+ unit MicroKeychain orders. Do not submit payment information through the quote form.

customProducts.headline: Custom product options
customProducts.intro: MicroPatches reviews custom requests for mini patch inspired products based on patch style artwork, badge artwork, logo artwork, emblem artwork, and other artwork references.
customProducts.developmentNote: Flexible Patch is available for custom quote review.
customProducts.reviewNote: If you have a unique custom request outside the listed product types, submit it for review. MicroPatches cannot guarantee that every custom request can be produced.

quoteForm.subject: New MicroPatches Custom Quote Request
quoteForm.intro: This is a quote request, not an automatic order. MicroPatches will review your request and follow up by email.
quoteForm.warning: Do not submit payment information through this form.
productTypes: Other custom request subject to review
artworkReferenceTypes: Existing agency or department patch design
quoteForm.uploadHelpText: Upload a photo or reference image of the patch, badge, logo, emblem, or artwork you want recreated as a MicroPatches product. This image is used only as a design reference for your requested product.
quoteForm.consentText: I understand this is a quote request, not an automatic order, and MicroPatches will review my request before confirming availability, pricing, or production.

footer.text: Mini patch inspired products for public safety, military, teams, supporters, and collectors.
